title: Bruno Mars Announces World Stadium Tour — And He’s Bringing a Bunch of Famous Friends With Him
summary: The Romantic Tour will feature guests Anderson .Paak, RAYE and more.
contentText:
Bruno Mars is gearing up to bring a little romance to cities all around the world, and Anderson .Paak, RAYE and more big names are coming along with him.

Related

Bruno Mars Returns: Superstar Announces New Album ‘The Romantic’

Rosé and Bruno Mars Spill Secrets Behind The Making of ‘APT.,’ 2025’s Biggest Global Hit

Bruno Mars Almost Scrapped ‘Die With a Smile’ Until This Lady Gaga Revelation Changed Everything

The superstar revealed on Thursday morning (Jan. 8) that his Romantic Tour will kick off in April following the release of his newly announced The Romance album. Running through mid-October, the trek will find Mars playing stadiums across North America and Canada.

His Silk Sonic bandmate will be a featured guest at all of the shows, while “Where Is My Husband!” singer RAYE, Victoria Monét and Leon Thomas will take turns as supporting acts on different dates.

Mars’ tour news comes on the heels of his announcement that, after 10 years, he’s finally coming back with his fourth solo album. The Romance will drop Feb. 27, a full decade after his last LP, 2016’s 24K Magic .

But even though it’s been a while since he released a solo full-length, the 16-time Grammy winner has been anything but unproductive in recent years. With .Paak, he formed Silk Sonic in 2021, and the duo scored a No. 1 hit on the Billboard Hot 100 that same year with “Leave the Door Open.” In 2025 alone, Mars closed out with two of the biggest hits of the year, with his Lady Gaga duet “Die With a Smile” finishing at No. 1 on Billboard ‘s year-end Hot 100 chart and ROSÉ collaboration “APT.” coming in at No. 10.
